title: Quick Energy Chinese Buckwheat Noodles
description: This lacto-vegetarian dish is a quick, energy-boosting option perfect for a busy weeknight dinner. Buckwheat noodles provide a rich source of fiber and protein to keep you going all day.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine buckwheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl, stirring with a wooden spoon until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it's smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
Cut the sheets into thin noodles using a pasta cutter or a sharp knife.
In a pressure cooker, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped scallions and grated ginger to the pot and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar to the pot and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the buckwheat noodles to the pot and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they're well coated with the sauce.
Cook the noodles in the pressure cooker for 3-4 minutes until they're al dente.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
